statement.name: ElliottTwistCandidate.elliott_twist_candidate
statement.type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℂ) {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  SemantEqCand.ElliottTwistCandidate.squaredDistanceConjTwist f χ t N =
    SemantEqCand.ElliottTwistCandidate.canonicalSquaredDistance f χ t N

comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℂ) {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  ∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N with Nat.Prime p,
      (1 - (f p * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ ↑p * Complex.exp (↑(t * Real.log ↑p) * Complex.I))).re) / ↑p =
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N with Nat.Prime p,
      (1 - (f p * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ ↑p * Complex.exp (↑(t * Real.log ↑p) * Complex.I))).re) / ↑p
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℂ) {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  ∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N with Nat.Prime p,
      (1 - (f p * star (χ ↑p * Complex.exp (↑(t * Real.log ↑p) * Complex.I))).re) / ↑p =
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N with Nat.Prime p,
      (1 - (f p * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ ↑p * Complex.exp (↑(t * Real.log ↑p) * Complex.I))).re) / ↑p

statement.name: ElliottTwistRef.elliott_twist_ref
statement.type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℂ) {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (t : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  SemantEqRef.ElliottTwistRef.squaredDistanceStar f χ t N = SemantEqRef.ElliottTwistRef.canonicalSquaredDistance f χ t N
